reviews.paired_negative_assessment_reason: Both versions of the history JS set link.href = itemUrl directly. After changes the selected URL field to html.escape(e.url), which replaces a legitimate query & delimiter with literal &. HTML5.2 DOM href setter stores the given attribute value rather than HTML-parsing character references, so a normal stored two-parameter URL navigates with changed query text. Old matched QUrl FullyEncoded history producer stores valid URL delimiters, and old projection passed them unchanged. This introduced selected producer/consumer navigation regression is distinct from correct title escaping at innerHTML and is not a new security-positive or a None-title exception.
